method: Marker-based signature scores are the mean of per-gene z-scores across samples; this is not xCell, CIBERSORT, MCP-counter, or a validated cell deconvolution estimate.
interpretation: The marker-based total-leukocyte score is higher in LPD dialysate effluent (P = 0.0010); this is an expression-signature association, not a direct cell-count or validated deconvolution estimate. After adjusting for leukocyte score as a covariate: TNFSF15 (P = 0.0036), CXCL14 (P = 0.0130), FLT3LG (P = 0.0167), and ADAM19 (P = 0.0400) retain nominal stage associations in these small-sample OLS models; this does not prove cell-intrinsic expression or causality. In contrast, EBI3 (P = 0.0532) becomes borderline, while SERPINA10 (P = 0.216) and LTB (P = 0.337) attenuate substantially, indicating that their associations are sensitive to adjustment for the marker-based score.
